scenario_description:
Objective: Use a short string-player body-use micro-session to add practical chair and shoulder setup ideas before Friday rehearsal.
Emerging Need: A general wellness-fair notice becomes a specific cancellable opening only after the rehearsal gap, price, and location make it feasible.
Decision Context: A saved conditioning note distinguishes worthwhile micro-sessions from generic add-ons; calendar, tour message, wallet, and fair updates establish whether a low-commitment hold fits.
Consequence: Timely preparation could preserve an optional coaching benefit without changing the rehearsal plan; ignoring it leaves the ordinary call unchanged, and after the hold cutoff the opening is gone.

parameter.title: Schubert chamber seating rehearsal

parameter.subject: Friday musician wellness fair cancellation watch
parameter.body: A small musician wellness fair will be in the MacPhail lobby on Friday afternoon. If any body-use or instrument-specific micro-session cancellations open, we will send a separate notice with exact times, cost, and hold instructions. Please do not request holds until a listed opening is posted.

parameter.content: Friday update: bus drop-off at MacPhail is now 12:55, Studio B opens at 13:45, and there is no section meeting before the 14:00 rehearsal. I am grabbing coffee in the lobby during that gap.

parameter.description: Cash per diem recorded for small same-week tour expenses.

parameter.subject: One viola-focused Alexander Technique micro-session opening Friday
parameter.body: Cancellation posted: a 15-minute Alexander Technique micro-session for violists is open Friday 13:10-13:25 in the MacPhail lobby consult nook. The instructor will focus on chair height, shoulder release, and bow-arm setup for seated rehearsal. Fee is $15 at check-in; no payment is needed to hold the name. We can hold one spot for replies received by 16:00 today with code VLA25.

parameter.subject: Friday viola micro-session opening released
parameter.body: The 13:10 viola-focused Alexander Technique micro-session has been released after the 16:00 hold cutoff. The fair desk cannot add additional names for that slot.
